run_control_trainer: run the ControlTrainer to fine-tune a diffusion model with control conditions for video or image generation
prepare_control_models: prepare diffusion models and control condition components for training with full finetune or LoRA
train_control_model: train a control model with gradient accumulation, checkpointing, and optional LoRA adapters
validate_control_model: validate a trained control model by generating videos or images from a validation dataset
save_control_checkpoint: save model checkpoints including LoRA weights or full transformer weights during training
